search_notes: EAGLE FM (inguinal vs ilio-inguinal lymphadenectomy, primary endpoint 5-year DFS). Registry (API, 2026-10-09): completed, primary completion 2024-10-17 actual, no results posted, last update 2025-05-09; enrolment field still shows the planned 634. Opened: the lymphoedema paper (PMID 38494565, Mar 2024) says the trial 'closed with 88 patients randomised because of slow recruitment and changes in melanoma management'; the economic evaluation (PMID 40016616, full text in Europe PMC, Feb 2025) says it 'was subsequently closed owing to futility, with only 101 of a target 634 patients recruited' and that the monitoring committee recommended follow-up continue; a PET/CT substudy (PMID 41240797, Nov 2025) says 101 randomised. None of these reports DFS. The economic paper gives only an overall-survival comparison (log-rank p=0.49, n=98), which is not the primary endpoint. No DFS result found in PubMed (acronym, intervention, investigator Spillane), Europe PMC (number, title), Crossref title scan (lymphadenectomy + melanoma + inguinal/groin/EAGLE, 2023 on) or one web search. Recorded as accrual stopped for enrolment reasons with no primary analysis public; a descriptive DFS report may still come. A web search summary (not opened) calls the design non-inferiority: flag for the exclusion review.

NACVCAC (First Hospital of Jilin University; neoadjuvant chemotherapy then capecitabine vs conventional adjuvant chemotherapy; 5-year DFS; 1,588 planned). Registry (API, 2026-10-09): status unknown, never updated since Jan 2017, estimated primary completion 2024-12, no results, one site. Nothing found: Europe PMC by number (one 2020 scoping review, not opened), PubMed by acronym and by the two listed investigators (Fan Zhimin, Han Bing) with Jilin affiliation, one Chinese-language web search (registry mirrors only). Medium because the completion date is nearly two years past, the record is nine years stale and Chinese-language journals and domestic meetings (CNKI, CSCO) could not be searched; the trial may never have enrolled as planned.

NSABP B-59/GBG-96-GeparDouze, SABCS 2024 abstract GS3-05. Opened: OncLive coverage dated 13 Dec 2024 (page metadata 2024-12-13T21:21Z), names NCT03281954: atezolizumab did not significantly improve EFS, 4-year EFS 85.2% vs 81.9%, HR 0.8 (95% CI 0.62-1.03), P=.08, median follow-up 46.9 months; OS HR 0.86 (0.62-1.19). The printed SABCS abstract (Crossref 10.1158/1557-3265.sabcs24-gs3-05, opened) carries no result: it says the event target was confirmed on 16 Sep 2024 and results would be 'available for presentation at SABCS 2024', so the meeting is the first disclosure; the article does not give the session day. Paper: Nature Medicine, 1 Sep 2026 (PMID 42680950, abstract opened): HR 0.80, P=0.083; the PubMed abstract prints the lower limit as 0.062, evidently 0.62. Registry record is stale (last update Apr 2024, estimated primary completion 2024-12-31, no results). No Roche or NSABP press release was looked for beyond one web search.

VAPOR-C (propofol vs sevoflurane and lidocaine vs none, 2x2 factorial, two primary DFS comparisons). Registry (API, 2026-10-09): terminated, why stopped 'Not meeting recruitment timelines', 254 actually enrolled against 3,500 planned in the registry description, primary completion 2025-02-28 actual, last update 2025-03-14, no results posted. An event-driven DFS analysis is not possible at 7% of target. No result found: PubMed ('VAPOR-C', investigator Riedel 2024-2026), Europe PMC by number (19 hits, all reviews or other protocols; a Sep 2025 protocol paper still calls VAPOR-C ongoing), Crossref title scan. No web search used.

Tata Memorial single-dose preoperative trastuzumab vs placebo (DFS; 1,100 planned). The registry record was changed after the sample was drawn: the API record fetched 2026-10-09 (update submitted 2026-10-06, posted 2026-10-09) shows TERMINATED, why stopped 'Low rate of recruitment and no financial support', primary completion 2026-09-11 actual, no results posted. The sample file has it as recruiting with 2025-04 estimated; registry_pcd is copied from the sample. The record still shows the planned 1,100 as an estimate, so the number actually enrolled is not public. No result found: Europe PMC by number (three reviews, not opened), PubMed by investigator (Badwe; Gupta, Nair, Hawaldar) with trastuzumab and preoperative/single dose, Crossref title scan (trastuzumab + preoperative/short/single dose, 2022 on), one web search (registry mirrors only).

CCTG MA.40/FINER, ASCO 2025 late-breaking abstract LBA1005. Opened: OncLive coverage dated 31 May 2025 (page metadata 2025-05-31T23:55Z), names NCT04650581: median PFS 5.32 vs 1.94 months, HR 0.61 (95% CI 0.46-0.81), two-sided P=.0007. Same numbers in the abstract text (Crossref 10.1200/jco.2025.43.17_suppl.lba1005, record created 2025-06-04, names the registry number) and in the results posted on the registry (2026-01-28). DATE DOUBT: the CCTG news item (ctg.queensu.ca/cctg_news/clinical-trial-shows-promise-slowing-advanced-breast-cancer-progression, opened) is stamped Friday 23 May 2025, the same day as the registry primary completion date, and says PFS improved (no numbers); but it says the results 'were presented at ASCO 2025', which began on 30 May, and its first web-archive capture is 2025-06-01. I did not rely on the stamp. If it is right, first disclosure is 2025-05-23, a press release with no hazard ratio, lag 0. No journal paper in PubMed as of 2026-10-09.

ISPNO 2024 abstract LGG-37 (Neuro-Oncology 26, Supplement_4; doi 10.1093/neuonc/noae064.428), found by Crossref title scan and read in full from the Crossref record. Its title is the registry title word for word, it reports 95 evaluable patients (registry: 95 enrolled) and its first author is the sponsor-investigator (spelt 'Lenen' in Crossref); it does not print the registry number. Result: in patients without NF1, 3-year PFS was 58% with carboplatin/vincristine (standard) vs 33% with monthly carboplatin (the research arm), p=0.04; with NF1, 71% vs 93%, p=0.08, 'statistically underpowered due to low accrual'. The research arm was therefore significantly worse in the larger stratum and not shown to be as good in the other: recorded not_met. No hazard ratio is given anywhere. The date is the supplement's online date (Crossref published-online 2024-06-18); the meeting dates were not checked. This is 14 months before the registry's actual primary completion date (2025-08-31); registry record completed, last update 2026-09-02, no results posted. No paper: PubMed (drug names + low grade glioma 2024-2026; investigator), Europe PMC by number (one 2020 letter), one web search (registry mirrors only). The registry asks whether carboplatin alone 'works as well as' the standard, an equivalence-type question with no stated margin: flag for the exclusion review.

Joint Astellas and HOVON press release of 9 Mar 2026 (opened): the HOVON 156 / AMLSG 28-18 / PASHA study 'did not meet its primary endpoint of overall survival (OS) at the primary analysis'; no numbers. The release gives no registry number; the three names match the registry's identifiers (HO156, AMLSG 28-18, Pasha). Hazard ratio first seen in OncLive coverage of the EHA 2026 Congress, dated 14 Jun 2026 (opened, names NCT04027309, abstract LB5005): HR 1.02 (95% CI 0.81-1.28), P=.864, median follow-up 43.2 months, 48-month OS 59% vs 60%. The late-breaking abstract may have gone online a few days before the coverage date. Found by web search; nothing in PubMed, and no HOVON 156 title in Crossref (ASH 2025 or earlier). Registry record is stale: last update Dec 2024, estimated primary completion 2025-10, no results. The word 'confirm' in the release title was not followed up; an earlier mention in an Astellas quarterly document was not looked for.

Escape (Sun Yat-sen University; PD-1 antibody + mXELIRI vs mXELIRI, second-line oesophageal squamous cell carcinoma; OS; 380 planned; investigator Rui-hua Xu). Registry (API, 2026-10-09): status unknown, last update Jan 2024, start Feb 2023, estimated primary completion 2026-02-17, no results. Nothing found: Europe PMC by number (one 2024 review, not opened), PubMed (irinotecan + capecitabine + oesophageal squamous 2023-2026; second-line + irinotecan + PD-1 names; investigator), Crossref title scan (XELIRI or irinotecan + oesophageal, 2023 on: no titles), one Chinese-language web search (registry mirrors only). Collaborators Junshi and Hengrui were not searched separately. High on the rule: completion date eight months past and every search empty; CSCO abstracts are not searchable.

which_endpoint: OS (randomisations 2 and 3: thiotepa added to fludarabine/busulphan conditioning)
search_notes: ASH 2025 abstract (Blood 146, Supplement 1; doi 10.1182/blood-2025-110; first author Craddock), 'Results of the UK IMPACT COSI trial', found by Crossref title scan and read in full from the Crossref record. It does not print the registry number; it is tied to this record by the trial name, the sponsor group, the design and the numbers (317 randomised; registry 333 enrolled). Result: the primary endpoint was OS; adding thiotepa did not improve 2-year OS in the myeloablative randomisation (75% vs 72%, p=0.73, n=99) or the reduced-intensity randomisation (71% vs 69%, p=0.87, n=218), with higher transplant-related mortality. No hazard ratio is given. DATE: 2025-11-03 is the supplement's issue date in Crossref and OpenAlex, which fits the usual early-November online release of ASH abstracts (not checked on the society's site); the Crossref DOI record was created 2025-12-04 and the meeting was in December. If the later date is preferred the lag is -162. The registry lists overall survival for 'all randomisations'. Randomisation 1 (Vyxeos vs intermediate-dose cytarabine before transplant) is marked 'closed to recruitment' in the registry and no result for it was found (Crossref, PubMed by investigator, one web search). Registry: active, not recruiting, last update 2026-05-05, estimated primary completion 2026-05, no results. Phase II/III multi-randomisation design: flag for the exclusion review.

IMM01-008 (ImmuneOnco, Hong Kong stock code 1541; timdarpacept + tislelizumab vs chemotherapy, classical Hodgkin lymphoma; PFS by independent review). Note the sponsor is a listed company. Registry (API, 2026-10-09): not yet recruiting, never updated since June 2024, no sites, estimated primary completion 2026-06, no results. Exchange filings read (index of 99 filing titles from 2025-06 to 2026-10-06, five documents opened): interim results of 26 Aug 2025 say first patient dosed July 2024 and 'recruitment is ongoing'; annual results of 25 Mar 2026 repeat the first dosing and report no safety issue to 31 Dec 2025 without the recruitment sentence; interim results of 26 Aug 2026 do not mention the phase III Hodgkin trial at all, describe only the completed phase II, and say resources are concentrated on the phase III CMML study. The two 2026 voluntary announcements titled 'updates on the clinical trial of IMM01' are about the CMML trial. No result announced; nothing in PubMed (IMM01, timdarpacept) or Europe PMC by number. One web search. The trial may have been quietly deprioritised; the company has not said so.

SWOG S1418/NRG BR006 (adjuvant pembrolizumab vs observation, triple-negative breast cancer with residual disease; invasive DFS plus two patient-reported primary outcomes). Registry (API, 2026-10-09): active, not recruiting, primary completion 2026-08-03 actual, last update 2026-08-31, no results posted, no linked publications. Nothing found: PubMed (S1418, BR006; investigator Pusztai; pembrolizumab + adjuvant + residual 2025-2026), Europe PMC by number (94 hits, reviews; a review of 21 Jul 2026, opened, says 'complete peer-reviewed final efficacy results are not yet available'), Crossref title scans (S1418; pembrolizumab + adjuvant/residual + breast from 2025-06, covering ASCO 2026 and SABCS 2025 supplements), one web search (trial listings only). The completion date is two months old; a first report at an autumn 2026 meeting is possible and would not yet be indexed.

ONCOCOL01 (University Hospital Toulouse; induction carboplatin/paclitaxel before chemoradiation vs chemoradiation alone, cervical cancer with para-aortic nodes; OS; 310 planned). Registry (API, 2026-10-09): recruiting, start July 2020, estimated primary completion 2026-09, last update Sep 2023, no results, no EU trial number on the record. Nothing found: Europe PMC by number (one 2022 review, not opened) and by acronym (no hits), PubMed (acronym; para-aortic + cervical + induction/neoadjuvant + randomised 2023-2026; investigator Motton), Crossref title scan (para-aortic + cervical + induction/neoadjuvant, 2023 on: no titles). No web search used. High on the rule that the estimated completion date is only just past; the record is three years stale and still shows recruiting.
